messageContext: Verbatim user reply in this Devin Desktop conversation immediately following the W002 decision card linked to frozen revision 2026-10-04-r1. The preceding Ready request authorized briefing, not implementation. This approval adopts only the presented W002 proposal, including its bounded subagent delegation and isolated synthetic workspace permissions.
materialBoundaries: One platform lead delegates one terminal worker then a distinct terminal reviewer. B1.1 and named shared leases only. Cached isolated local workspace/synthetic PostgreSQL test containers after preflight; no pulls, installations, purchases, model/global config changes, host candidate execution, production data, restricted-code execution, public routes/UI, B1.2 or later tasks. Specific destructive actions still require explicit confirmation.
checkpointAuthority: Routine exact-reviewed commits/non-force pushes to existing private origin/master use docs/box-v4/GIT-CHECKPOINTS.md standing authority, not this approval. No unreviewed outgoing scope, PR or other destination.
notes: Actual brief digest and base were rechecked before recording approval. Frozen brief remains unchanged. Holds, revocation and material changes stop dispatch; completion cannot approve the next wave. Timestamp is the observation time, not an invented user-message transport timestamp.
